reason: This paper investigates the usage of FPGA devices for energy-efficient exact kNN search in high-dimension latent spaces. This work intercepts a relevant trend that tries to support the increasing popularity of learned representations based on neural encoder models by making their large-scale adoption greener and more inclusive. The paper proposes two different energy-efficient solutions adopting the same FPGA low-level configuration.
